GitHub #608's design (mitcad#2330; tools/cli/fillet-full-round-order-reported-test.cmake) with Fillet1 (11) moved before Fillet2 (14.2), the order that left a step: Fillet2's contact on the bottom runs off it onto Fillet1's rounding near the end face, and the rounding was ended on the end face's plane alone, a lip standing out past Fillet1's rounding at the step's height. Now the material Fillet2 adds ends at Fillet1's rounding continued down past the bottom: the same body as in the design's own order (the test compares the volumes the two runs report).
No plane facing up at the step's height (a lip's top); the top faces up.
